purpose: Descriptive replay of already frozen policies; no new tuning or deployment change
policy_family: All reported_points and fixed_baselines in adaptive_selection_v1/policy.json, including chosen; plus matched C1, B, B+BM25, and P3-on-all Test replay
policy_selection: None. Test was already exposed before this analysis. The pointwise Pareto frontier is descriptive, not a new selected policy or independent confirmation.
quality: Frozen judge-assisted labels, with existing source priority and team RAG last on Test. Missing labels never become false. Identical predictions cancel exactly in paired differences.
cost: Total 7B generation calls = 1 C1 + executed B calls + conditional BM25 calls + distinct uncached selection generations. Include failed/rejected generations. Context count is not call count. Retrieval, scoring, diagnosis and time are separate metrics.
latency: Use original warmed-up 300-question single-query timing receipts. For earlier stopping/gating, retain each item's recorded prefix generation time and full measured selector overhead from the 2440 run; add its 300-run C1+diagnosis+controller time. This is a two-run component estimate, not measured counterfactual latency. No imputation when a required context was not timed.

statistics.method: Paired item percentile bootstrap (multinomial over -1,0,+1 for binary differences)
statistics.difference_tests: exact paired McNemar, Holm across all listed comparisons within each dataset
statistics.noninferiority: Report one-sided 95% lower bounds and descriptive 0.5pp / 2pp margin sensitivity only; not pre-registered confirmatory tests

exclusions: No gold-context oracle as a deployable policy
No pricing or money-saving claims inferred from call counts
No modification of labels using the assistant oracle review
